people.name: Albert Grünwedel
people.field: Indologist, Tibetologist, archaeologist, and explorer of Central Asia

relations.subject: Albert Grünwedel
relations.evidence: in 1883 obtained his doctorate at the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München.

relations.subject: Albert Grünwedel
relations.evidence: In 1881, he began work as an assistant at the Museum of Ethnology in Berlin

relations.subject: Albert Grünwedel
relations.role: deputy director of the ethnographic collection
relations.evidence: in 1883 he was appointed deputy director of the ethnographic collection.

relations.subject: Albert Grünwedel
relations.evidence: In 1899, Grünwedel was invited to join a Russian archaeological research expedition led by Vasily Radlov into the north of Xinjiang province, China.

relations.subject: Albert Grünwedel
relations.evidence: In the same year he was appointed a member of the Bavarian Academy of Sciences.

relations.subject: Albert Grünwedel
relations.evidence: Grünwedel was joined by Heinrich Lüders who made major contributions to the epigraphical analysis of the Turpan-Expedition findings

relations.subject: Heinrich Lüders
relations.evidence: after being called to the Friedrich Wilhelm University of Berlin as Professor for oriental languages in 1909.
